overview: شلک هولمز زمانی که زنان جوان در اطراف لندن کشته می‌شوند و هر کدام انگشت‌شان قطع شده، تحقیق می‌کند. اسکاتلند یارد معتقد است که یک دیوانه درگیر است، اما هولمز معتقد است که این قتل‌ها بخشی از یک طرح شیطانی هستند.
overview_en: The 11th film in the Rathbone/Bruce Sherlock Holmes series, "The Woman In Green" explores Professor Moriarty's plan to blackmail wealthy gentlemen, making them think they murdered the young female victims of a Jack The Ripper style serial killer. This is a slightly better print than the others already available on the Internet Archive. Copyright Status: PUBLIC DOMAIN Registered for copyright LP13455 25 July 1945: THE WOMAN IN GREEN. Universal Pictures Co., Inc., 1945. 7 reels, sd. Based on the "Sherlock Holmes" characters created by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. Credits: Director, Roy William Neill; original screenplay, Bertram Millhauser; music director, Mark Levant; film editor, Edward Curtiss. Universal Pictures Co., Inc.; 27Jul45; LP13455. NO RENEWALS FOUND
